messages:
lucy: dropped a compact timeline mock focusing on patterned legend and tactile targets -> https://figma.com/file/compact. intent: make variant legend decodeable without color.
marco: pattern glyphs look good. can we compress the legend on mobile to a horizontal scroll with a chevron to expand?
lucy: yes, horizontal scroll by default, chevron expands full list. touch targets kept >=44px.
noor: SR notes: each legend item must be keyboard-focusable and announce via aria-live: 'Canary v3.2, 15% traffic, cohort: web'. include aria-describedby linking to timeline.
a11y-bot: checklist: pattern glyph alt text, legend contrast >4.5:1, focus order (legend -> timeline -> inspector), test with NVDA.
marco: rollback flow: action menu (kebab) per variant rather than inline chips. menu opens modal with reason, collapsed Impact (latency/cost), and post-rollback preview.
lucy: modal will be aria-modal and trap focus. will include microcopy: 'Requires 2FA and workspace admin for prod' under primary button. primary label: 'Confirm and rollback traffic'.
noor: after action show undo snackbar: 'Rollback executed. Undo available for 5 minutes.' snackbar must be keyboard-focusable and announced via aria-live.
lucy: will update designs and add an a11y handoff checklist in file comments. posting revised link in ~30m. leaving thread open for any last nits.
thread_summary: Compact timeline design: patterned, focusable legend with horizontal scroll on mobile; action menu + modal rollback flow with aria-modal, 2FA copy, collapsed impact, and keyboard-focusable undo snackbar.
